scope.honest_holdout_claim: New-model parameters, hyperparameters, checkpoints, and reporting rules are frozen before the model's first W-target evaluation.
scope.not_claimed: The research team had never seen modern aggregate results when designing the architecture.
scope.permitted_prior_modern_information: The frozen 80/20 blend's existing aggregate and transition-level modern scores and audited universe counts, used only as evaluator reproduction assertions; no new-model modern score is permitted before the lock.

text_embedding.historical_cache_build: one content-deduplicated H1-H12 build from the locked local model tree before fitting
text_embedding.cpu_dtype_policy: CPU-only; explicitly call model.float() before encoding

model.other_architecture_and_optimizer_setting: fixed identically across widths before first fit

objective.name: ListNet-style listwise softmax cross-entropy
objective.transition_reduction: one equal-frequency optimizer update per transition per epoch; arithmetic mean only for the epoch training trace

training.updates: one optimizer update per transition; seed-determined transition order within each epoch

historical_selection.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean within each validation transition
historical_selection.validation_slot_definition: one validation transition after averaging its three seed-specific NDCG@5 values

baseline.name: frozen 80/20 return-path plus TF-IDF percentile-rank blend

width_selection.criterion: largest equal-slot mean NDCG@5 advantage over the frozen blend

continuation_gate.win_definition: strictly positive unrounded model-minus-baseline slot difference

final_historical_fit.modern_transition_score: arithmetic mean of five separately evaluated seed scores

lock_manifest_minimum_contents: data contract and historical input identities
production-only execution attestation with identical pre-fit, post-selection, and post-final snapshots
exact aligned ticker, return, text-embedding, text, and historical target identities
selected width and complete training settings
historical slot results and gate decision
modern_target_lock.transition_access_order: verify/load feature inputs; freeze all peer lists; hash target files into the existing marker; load target content
forbidden_prelock_operations: score the new model against a W target

baseline.name: frozen 80/20 return-path plus TF-IDF percentile-rank blend

paper_inclusion_gate.win_definition: five-seed mean model NDCG@5 strictly exceeds the same-transition frozen blend NDCG@5
paper_inclusion_gate.strict_application_survival_definition: Rankings freeze on the feature-time-only universe before target availability; incomplete query-list pairs are dropped without reranking; there is no target-dependent selection; and the equal-transition mean model-minus-blend difference in query-basket residual correlation remains positive.

failure_policy.historical_gate_failure: Stop before modern target access; archive the historical negative result; leave the manuscript unchanged; do not try a rescue configuration.
failure_policy.modern_gate_failure: Archive the complete result; do not add the model to the paper's main claims; do not tune or rerun on W1->W7.
failure_policy.prelock_modern_target_access: Invalidate confirmatory status and stop paper inclusion under this protocol.
failure_policy.missing_candidate_fold_or_seed: Stop; do not reduce the denominator or select only completed runs.
failure_policy.injected_execution_seam: Test-only; it may create only a TEST_ONLY manifest and is never eligible for modern evaluation.
failure_policy.execution_snapshot_change: Stop without a production lock if any source, input file, or aligned array identity changes during selection or final fitting.
failure_policy.hardware_interruption: Rerun only the identical seed with identical code, inputs, and configuration.
failure_policy.mechanical_failure_before_target_output_: A logged correction and identical-protocol rerun are allowed.
failure_policy.work_after_stop: Treat as exploratory; require a new protocol and a genuinely later evaluation period.
